notes.title: Update 1.5.0 (Part 3 The War of Ideologies,Private Corps)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The story of " The War of Ideologies"  has been added. (The empire invaded the Medes kingdom with overwhelming power, but the war was not over. The horrors of the war caused numerous problems, and the empire began a war against ideology.)

The Empire will use all means and methods to obtain the legitimacy of the invasion and removal of internal and external complaints.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41675965/c118b7c7bf3a87d8a2c9092988bd4dbaf30292d1.gif[/img]

Players should investigate the propaganda behavior taking place in the empire. (Investigation should collect evidence from Propaganda and ensure that imperial citizens know the truth. However, investigation can lead to very dangerous consequences)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41675965/12dd0d1b690403f7dd3135849eebaa9b488abcae.gif[/img]

The secret base is full of puzzles. Solve your enemies' traps and collect physical evidence of propaganda.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41675965/35298c34bfb036894d27c121f3d29a3aaae6d54c.gif[/img]

Investigating propaganda is a very dangerous act that reveals the fatal secrets of the empire. During the investigation, you must defeat the enemy who interferes with the player.

[*] Personal mercenary contents  has been added. (Players can build their own mercenaries and hire new mercenaries. New mercenaries should be fostered, properly deployed and utilized according to their characteristics to collect and resolve customer requests. Successful resolution of the request can increase the funds and reputation of the mercenaries.) ※ The reputation of the mercenaries affects the ending.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41675965/986e43ce9c60be6e046c1e6fd5b048ef2d0caa29.gif[/img]

Please proceed with the contract with the mercenaries you need in the guild. (Contracts should take into account the contract period and salary.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41675965/671b47768015a9cea6af7330704494d660e9601b.gif[/img]

Please proceed with the request with the mercenaries you have hired. The success probability of the request is (mercenary level, attack, defense, magic attack, magic defense, etc.)

[*] There will be additional content on the sale of war-related goods. (Players can sell and purchase goods to empires and kingdoms at regular intervals, and unexpected things can expose them to the risk of loss and bankruptcy.)

[*] A jumping system  has been added. (Players can route items, solve puzzles, and lift hidden elements by jumping hills and high slopes.)

In order to jump, you have to press the dash key while running ex)Shift key

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41675965/4a3d1f2e96e8fc63cc2757694140a76eee8e5b91.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41675965/f0fc7d486396eb735f5b7fcb93e546150adfa1d2.gif[/img]

Use Jump to get hidden items and solve puzzles. ※ Certain maps can only be passed by jumping.

[*] A rank maze with a stronger enemy  has been added.

[*] Camera viewpoint reset has been added. (Camera view will be reset as of 00:00)

[*] A total of more than five new areas and hunting grounds  has been added.
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to the release of F-RANK hero story and update in the future.
notes.content:
Hi there!ːsteamhappyː

We welcome the launch and would like to explain the future update schedule.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41675965/820d6204d3cd29d0914a69e570f9eb0d6f2396cf.jpg[/img]

Prepare for a tough but great journey - the "controlled world" has to prepare various strategies for money politics.

As a result of our development team's discussion, we don't want to leave food and water simply for survival to express the long-term impact of money on politics.

For example: cheaper, less nutritious food and long-term contaminated water will leave the character undernourished. This will affect the character's body (stat) in the long run.

Conversely, long-term consumption of more expensive and rich nutrition and refined water will have a positive effect on the character's body (stat), resulting in a stronger body.

In addition, contents such as self-owned mercenaries, stocks, and real estate investments will be updated.

The update time will be about 2 weeks.

The F-RANK Hero Story is out today for $9.99 USD on Steam - with a 10% launch discount until January 12! 🚀
